Demo switches. The Organization (Company / Government) and Role (Manager / Staff) switches simulate who is signed in. In production the screens and panels are selected automatically from the user's profile (organization type, role, site and district from single sign-on); users do not choose them by hand.
Disaster Compass Central Asia (mock)

A prototype disaster-preparedness app for risk managers and staff of companies and local governments with sites in Central Asia. Figures on screen are of two kinds: public information with its source stated, and assumed values (demo) with their basis stated. For real evacuation decisions, follow local authorities and your embassy.

Build 2026-11-16 Map: Natural Earth (public domain) Seismic loss: GEM Foundation Country Seismic Risk Profiles v2026 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial) Hazard levels: ThinkHazard! (GFDRR) Access: in production, screens and panels are selected automatically from the signed-in user's organization, role, site and district; the Organization / Role switches are a demo substitute.
